origin.description: Run code with the library path list replaced.
origin.details: The default action is replace, so the list contains only the new path during code.
origin.example:
dir.create("/tmp/withr-lib-check", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
before <- .libPaths()
first <- with_libpaths("/tmp/withr-lib-check", normalizePath(.libPaths()[[1]]))
c(first, if (identical(.libPaths(), before)) "restored" else "open")

translation.description: Run code with the library path list replaced.
translation.details: The default action is replace, so the list contains only the new path during code. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

os.makedirs("/tmp/withr-lib-check", exist_ok=True)
before = libpaths()
first = with_libpaths("/tmp/withr-lib-check", lambda: libpaths()[0])
flag = "restored" if libpaths() == before else "open"
return [first, flag]
